segments.source: Saturdays.AI is a leading social impact organization dedicated to democratize artificial intelligence (AI4All), while building open-source projects (AI4Good).
segments.en: Saturdays.AI is a leading social impact organization dedicated to democratize artificial intelligence (AI4All), while building open-source projects (AI4Good).

segments.source: Our flagship program, AI Saturdays, is a 4-month-long, in-person bootcamp held on Saturdays. It brings together participants from diverse backgrounds, united by a shared passion for learning artificial intelligence and making a meaningful impact through collaborative projects.
segments.en: Our flagship program, AI Saturdays, is a 4-month-long, in-person bootcamp held on Saturdays. It brings together participants from diverse backgrounds, united by a shared passion for learning artificial intelligence and making a meaningful impact through collaborative projects.
segments.es: Nuestro programa principal, AI Saturdays, es un bootcamp presencial de 4 meses de duración que se lleva a cabo los sábados. Reúne a participantes de diversos orígenes, unidos por una pasión compartida por aprender inteligencia artificial y generar un impacto significativo a través de proyectos colaborativos.
Charlas con grandes creadores y expertos.
